title: Uniform torsion exponent from local eventual charts
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite normed Q_ℓ-extension, X a scheme with noetherian underlying space, and P locally finitely presented over its continuous integral coefficient ring [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. There is one N such that image(ℓ^N id_P) becomes finite free on a pro-etale cover and the underlying set sheaf of cokernel(ℓ^N id_P) becomes a constant finite set sheaf on a pro-etale cover. Empty schemes and zero quotients are allowed.

source.place: Section 6.8 integral coefficient framework; quasi-compact covering refinement and inverse-image adjunctions

proof.text: Obtain local charts and a bound on each chart valid for every larger exponent.

Apply Mathlib QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom to the cover with its quasi-compact condition forgotten. Noetherianity makes X compact and quasi-separated. The resulting finite affine weakly etale cover has quasi-compact arrows and hence is a pro-etale cover by QuasiCompactCover.of_finite and Cover.ofQuasiCompactCover.
Take the finite supremum of the bounds on the retained source charts. It is at least every such bound, including when the index type is empty.
Pull back the image free bases along the refining arrows and use the proved free_pullback_comp_iff coefficient comparison.

For finite quotient set charts, compare composite inverse image by conjugating the direct-image composition isomorphism under adjunctions. Use the existing upstream Functor.constantSheafsheafPullbackIso and the generic sheafPullbackIso to compare constant sheaves with the constructed inverse image. The pro-etale base-change functor preserves terminal objects by its finite-limit preservation instance. Compose these comparisons with the finite constant chart isomorphisms.

proof_origin.note: D4: globalizes the local eventual charts by a finite affine refinement and a finite maximum. The inverse-image comparisons use adjunction uniqueness and the existing upstream constant-sheaf pullback comparison. All steps are proved.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_lfp_finite_quotient_charts
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
    (hP : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X) P) :
    ∃ N : ℕ,
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
          (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj
            (image ((ℓ ^ N) • 𝟙 P)))) ∧
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty
          ((Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage (C.f s) (Type (u + 1))).obj
            ((Mod.forget _ ⋙ sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              (forget Ab.{u + 1})).obj (cokernel ((ℓ ^ N) • 𝟙 P))) ≅
            (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (C.X s)) (Type (u + 1))).obj
              (ULift.{u + 1} (Fin n))))
